## Why this matters
PR #395 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 and PR #402 was merged on 2026-06-14 without closing the R81 audit findings from the combined first-payment notification surface. Feature is behind `FEATURE_ROMAN_FIRST_PAYMENT` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the combined PR #395/#402 surface is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **N1 (P1)** `FIRST_PAYMENT` push can be lost after rollback + Stripe retry within 60s — `recentPushes` (module-level process state) is mutated before the ambient transaction commits; if the outer Stripe webhook transaction rolls back and Stripe redelivers within 60s, the retry commits the in-app row but suppresses the push row; PR #402 regression tests neutralize this by advancing fake time 120s on every read, hiding the actual production retry window — `src/notifications/notifications.service.ts:317-328` — fix: move `recentPushes` mutation to after transaction commit, or use a transactional deduplication table rather than in-process state

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audits (PR #395 F1–F8 all closed by PR #402) + post-merge re-audit complete. Original findings F1–F8 from the PR #395 audit are resolved on current `main`. N1 is the single remaining open finding, verified against current `main`.
